# GitHub Copilot adapter

Before proposing a change, follow the repository-root `AGENTS.md` and the
nearest nested `AGENTS.md` for the edited path.  Use `ai/project-map.yml` for
location and `ai/test-matrix.yml` for validation.  Repository source and tests
override explanatory documentation when they disagree.

修改前读取根级及目标路径最近的 `AGENTS.md`；定位使用 `ai/project-map.yml`，
验证使用 `ai/test-matrix.yml`。本文件不维护第二套规则。
